articles.headline_raw:
India hands
over defence
equipment
and stores to
the Maldives
articles.body_raw:
SHUBHAJIT ROY
NEW DELHI, JANUARY 8

INDIA “HANDED over defence
equipment and stores to the
Makdives” and Defence Ministers
Rajnath Singh and Mohamed
Ghassan Maumoon met in New
Delhi Wednesday as the two
countries moved to restore ties
after a hiatus that spread rancour
in the twocapitals.
Singh and Maumoon held
talks to “deepen defence coop-
eration”, “enhance capability of
the Maldives National Defence
Forces" and “add new vigour"
toties.

Maumoon, 44, isthe younger
son of former Maldives President
Maumoon Abdul Gayoom who
ruled the country for three
decades. He had served inthe
Presidency of hisuncle, Abdulla
Yameen Abdul Gayoom, as State
minister at the President's office
and later at Social Affairs.
Yameen led the ‘India Out’ cam-
paign whicheventually brought
Mohamed Muizzu to powerin
November 2023, and ties with
India headed south shortly
thereafter.
articles.headline: India hands over defence equipment and stores to the Maldives
articles.text:
INDIA "HANDED over defence equipment and stores to the Makdives" and Defence Ministers Rajnath Singh and Mohamed Ghassan Maumoon met in New Delhi Wednesday as the two countries moved to restore ties after a hiatus that spread rancour in the twocapitals. Singh and Maumoon held talks to "deepen defence cooperation", "enhance capability of the Maldives National Defence Forces" and "add new vigour" toties.

Maumoon, 44, isthe younger son of former Maldives President Maumoon Abdul Gayoom who ruled the country for three decades. He had served inthe Presidency of hisuncle, Abdulla Yameen Abdul Gayoom, as State minister at the President's office and later at Social Affairs. Yameen led the 'India Out' campaign whicheventually brought Mohamed Muizzu to powerin November 2023, and ties with India headed south shortly thereafter.
